mapper.select: SELECT sch.id, sch.class_id, sch.course_id, sch.teacher_id, sch.day_of_week, sch.period, sch.room_number, sch.semester, sch.create_time, sch.update_time, sch.is_deleted, c.class_name, co.course_name, t.name AS teacher_name FROM schedule sch LEFT JOIN `class` c ON sch.class_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN course co ON sch.course_id = co.id AND co.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN teacher t ON sch.teacher_id = t.id AND t.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sch.class_id = #{classId} AND sch.semester = #{semester} AND sch.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sch.day_of_week, sch.period

SELECT sch.id, sch.class_id, sch.course_id, sch.teacher_id, sch.day_of_week, sch.period, sch.room_number, sch.semester, sch.create_time, sch.update_time, sch.is_deleted, c.class_name, co.course_name, t.name AS teacher_name FROM schedule sch LEFT JOIN `class` c ON sch.class_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN course co ON sch.course_id = co.id AND co.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN teacher t ON sch.teacher_id = t.id AND t.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sch.id = #{id} AND sch.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schedule (class_id, course_id, teacher_id, day_of_week, period, room_number, semester, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{classId}, #{courseId}, #{teacherId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{period}, #{roomNumber}, #{semester}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule SET course_id = #{courseId}, teacher_id = #{teacherId}, room_number = #{roomNumber}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM schedule WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert:
